tools.name: search_sky
tools.description: Search Sky Darkroom, a free night sky site and astrophotography game: real objects (Andromeda Galaxy, Orion Nebula, the Pleiades, Messier and NGC objects, planets) with constellation, distance, brightness, a checked fact with source, and guides (stacking, stretching, seeing, magnitude, light-years).

tools.name: sky_this_month
tools.description: The night sky right now from Sky Darkroom: Moon phase, the next meteor shower, coming planet events (oppositions, best evening and morning views) and the best Messier objects in the evening sky this month, for the Northern and Southern Hemisphere. Use when someone asks what to see in the sky tonight

tools.name: astrophotography_game
tools.description: Sky Darkroom: Capture the real night sky and develop it like an astronomer. A calm free browser game with the real sky over the player's home: point a telescope, capture in real time, develop the frames (stacking, stretching, color) in a darkroom and build a sky log, with real photos from NASA, ESA,
